parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website to query.

> The domain must have been configured with website business forwarding rules. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~DescribeDomains~~) to query all domains that have been configured with website business forwarding rules.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The list of DDoS protection instance IDs to query.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: **1** to **10**.

parameters.name: QueryDomainPattern
parameters.description:
The query matching pattern. Values:
- **fuzzy** (default): Indicates fuzzy query.
- **exact**: Indicates exact query.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID of the DDoS protection instance in the resource management service.

Not setting this parameter indicates the default resource group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddoscoo describe-web-rules --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --domain example.com --cname kzmk7b8tt3510000.aliyunddos10140000 --query-domain-pattern exact --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-i7m27nf30000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
